# Reddi Agent Protocol

> An open marketplace for paid AI inference on Solana. Providers list a price per million tokens; buyers and their agents lock the most a call can cost in escrow, pay only for the tokens used, and get a signed receipt for every call.

Reddi Agent Protocol (RAP) answers the Solana Foundation's Request for Startups item "An open marketplace for AI inference" (https://solana.com/request-for-startups#ai-inference-marketplace): let developers choose, verify and pay inference providers through one interface. We started building it in March 2026, months before that item was published. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Solana Foundation.

Why Solana: agent payments are frequent and small, so they need a public, verifiable ledger that settles faster than an agent waits and costs almost nothing per call. On Solana a payment confirms in under a second and the network fee is about 0.000005 SOL per transaction, still a tiny fraction of a cent with a priority fee added. A metered call is two transactions (lock and settle, 5,000 lamports base fee each). Measured on devnet for a real code review that cost about $0.04 (0.000284 SOL): the lock fee was 0.000013 SOL including the wallet's priority fee, the settle fee 0.000005 SOL, about 0.000018 SOL ($0.003) in all at $150/SOL. Mainnet uses the same base fee; priority fees vary with load.

Running on Solana devnet. Mainnet is coming soon. This site is the overview; the app at https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech is where agents and providers get started, and its own llms.txt lists everything they need.

## Agents and developers

- [App llms.txt](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/llms.txt): the full index for buying agents and service providers.
- [Full text for LLMs](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/llms-full.txt): the buyer skill, the provider skill and the pricing page in one file.
- [Buyer skill](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/skill.md): how a buying agent finds a provider, gets a quote, pays from an escrow lock and checks the receipt.
- [Provider skill](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/provider.md): how to run a paid, per-token provider with the @redditech/provider-kit CLI and list it with an ADL v0.3 document.
- [Pricing and fees](https://app.agent-protocol.reddi.tech/pricing.md): per-token pricing, the buyer's maximum, the planned 5% protocol fee with its 2.5% launch rate for payouts before 1 April 2027 (UTC), and the 0.1 SOL cap on SOL payments. Judge-free payback: on Budgets with no judge, the fee on every payout that lands before 1 April 2027 00:00 UTC is paid back to the provider on 1 April 2027, in the same token, with a soulbound receipt NFT; later payouts pay the standard 5% with nothing back. RAP's own providers and the RAP treasury are excluded. It does not stack with the Founding Provider rebate, which counts only fees on judged Budgets.
